career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but knowing how to run a site without knowing the numbers. Scheduling will become digital, and only managers who can control budgets, lead people, and withstand site pressure can navigate both industry cycles and AI disruption.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but industry cycles plus heavy responsibility. Fluctuations in real estate and infrastructure investment directly affect jobs, while responsibility for safety, quality, schedule, and cost rests on the manager. Heavy safety and quality accountability with zero tolerance for serious failures

安全质量责任重，一票否决

career_path_block.说明: PLC and variable-frequency drive skills are in short supply

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is allowing skills to remain at the level of traditional electrical work. PLC and predictive-maintenance skills support progression into engineering and gain value with experience.

Skill change: workers without automation knowledge lose relevance
Urgent-repair pressure: downtime creates major losses and responsibility
Occupational hazards: heights, dust, and noise

responsibilities: Install and commission electrical equipment and wiring
Execute maintenance plans and keep service records

responsibilities: 安装调试电气设备与线路
更换元器件并恢复运行
执行保养计划并记录档案

Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
